key_points: Intel fell ~29% in one session, its worst day since 1974; October was down ~45%, the worst month since at least 1980
Despite an 8th straight earnings/guidance beat, weak Q4 guidance drove the collapse and reset near-term expectations
The U.S. government stake/bet on Intel is down ~$35.1 billion, increasing political and regulatory scrutiny
Intel's foundry turnaround now faces a critical test after the plunge, threatening the core recovery thesis
Analysts remain mixed with no strong buy case; fair-value estimates have been cut after weak guidance
